description: Metadata pointer from a file row to its binary payload in internal CAS storage.

id.description: File primary-key value (matches lix_file.id) for this binary reference row.

blob_hash.description: BLAKE3 content hash used as the canonical CAS key for the binary payload.

size_bytes.description: Logical uncompressed file size in bytes for the referenced binary payload.

plugin_checkpoint.description: Authenticated durable WASM plugin checkpoint for this file owner.

generation.description: Monotonic plugin generation selected for this BlobRef.

semantic_root.description: Authenticated semantic root associated with the plugin checkpoint.

runtime.description: URL-safe base64 encoded runtime checkpoint bytes.

authority.description: URL-safe base64 encoded checkpoint authority bytes.
